## About
Bob Howell worked on his first car engine when he was just a freshman in high school. That fascination with the machinery that makes a car go turned into a career, and Bob became known to his customers for fairness, honesty and excellent workmanship.
Today reviewers name Aaron, the owner, and Jose, the manager, as the people who dig in on a tough problem and tell you straight what needs to be done now and what can wait if you're on a budget.
The lot stays busy, so plan on leaving your car with us for the day. Olympic Auto is rated 4.6 on Google from 186 reviews.

## Services
- Oil change: Old oil thickens, picks up metal slivers and dust, and loses its lubricating qualities. When we change your oil, we also look over the engine and let you know about worn or cracked belts, uneven tire wear, or anything else that isn't in tip top condition.
- Free estimate: Call or come by and we'll take a look and tell you what we find.

## FAQ
Q: How long will my car be at the shop?

Q: Will you tell me if a repair isn't worth it?
A: Yes. One reviewer says if you ask whether the vehicle is worth fixing, you'll get a truthful answer.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 7:30 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.
